hook.name: LaunchpadFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a flat fee (default 1%) on exact-input swaps by taking the input currency via BeforeSwapDelta custom accounting, splitting it between the pool's registered creator (default 75%) and a platform treasury (default 25%) as claimable ERC-6909 credits. Exact-output swaps are rejected. Only factory-registered pools are accepted; fee rate and treasury address are adjustable by a designated timelock within hardcoded bounds (max 3% total, min 30% creator share).
